title: Quarantine record v1
description: What the store keeps about the frames the collector would not trust, aggregated by the collector to one record per frame type and 60-second window: why, what type they claimed, how many there were, how big the largest was, and a short digest of the first (null when the collector did not compute one; the Pass 2 collector sends null). It carries no payload, no prompt text and no Crew slot key. frameType is a bounded token, or the literal invalid when the claimed type does not fit the token pattern (V3.1-19). count is the number of frames the record stands for (at least 1); firstReceivedAtMs is null when the collector did not keep the first receive time.
